## Latest Scoped Configuration (October 23, 2026; 23:39 Beijing Time)

The latest authorized operation removed one whitelist entry while retaining its
blacklist entry. Three groups' moderation rules and future-rejoin mute durations
were aligned to seven days/10,080 minutes, not the product default of29 days.
Deployed API readback confirmed matching persisted/runtime rules and no list
overlaps. No campaign content or member lists were copied; no actual group command
or native sanction was tested. Addition still never immediately punishes.
The22:59/23:13 “no member changes/overlap retained” entries below describe earlier
snapshots only. See the dated maintenance section; never infer live settings
or new sanction acceptance from documentation.

## List Exclusivity And Removal (October 23, 2026; Loaded At 22:59:23 Beijing Time)

New additions are exclusive by bot/group/UID: reject membership in the other list
and explicitly require its removal first; never transfer/delete automatically.
Retain historical overlaps with blacklist precedence; remove each entry separately.
Removal uses the list-row icon, preview and confirmation, or removal-mode lookup
by current name, saved old name or exact UID, including departed/renamed members.
Adding still searches the real current roster by name, never blindly by UID.
Removing one list never removes the other; blacklist removal never unmutes.

历史允许重叠仅作迁移说明，保留旧记录、黑名单优先、分别移除，不自动转移／删除。

## Loaded Blacklist Duration Baseline (October 23, 2026; Predates This Fix)

Every trusted actual rejoin directly mutes and retains a blacklisted member,
never kicks; addition never immediately punishes. Per-bot/group duration defaults
to 29 days/41,760 minutes, configurable to 1..41760 whole minutes with
`黑名单禁言时长 N分钟` / `黑名单禁言时长 N小时` / `黑名单禁言时长 N天`.
Select the group first in DMs, preview and personally send `确认黑名单 token`.
Dashboard: Group Management -> Rules -> Blacklist Settings.
Changes affect future rejoins only, never reset existing mutes or apply
retrospective sanctions. The ordinary 24-hour mute cap and permissions remain.
Old three-kick-then-fixed-mute behavior is dated history, not current acceptance.
The user's “看得见” confirms the corresponding phone display only, not future
actual expiry or new-policy acceptance. The full restart completed at20:02:56
Beijing time, October23,2026 (PID2602695 ->3317496, NRestarts=0).
Online configuration verification restored41,760 after preview/commit/read of60.
Offline regression passed; no new actual rejoin/mute acceptance was performed.
The20:24:00 protection review matched other protected surfaces and accounted for
test tenant217->220 plus concurrent Dingfeng1459534 dashboard versions4/5.
Raw tenants hashes differ; audited concurrent changes were preserved, not rolled back.

当前契约：每次可信真实重入直接禁言不踢人，加入不立即处罚；默认29天41760分钟，
按机器人＋群设置1..41760整分钟，私信先选群、预览后本人确认；后台「群管理→规则→黑名单设置」。
仅影响后续重入，不重设已有禁言或追罚；旧三踢保留历史，手机「看得见」不证明未来真实到期。

不宣称原始整体hash全同或正式群从未变动；并发修改未覆盖、未回滚。

verification. This pass writes only `dashboard/public/local-docs/`, never dist.
Final dist synchronization and served-hash verification remain with the owner.
Generation does not prove new actual rejoin/mute acceptance. After owner publication,
these files are available under the deployed Dashboard's `/local-docs/`.
